bio: Bragnott is the will of Stoneloom's Elder Kings made manifest. Birthed to repel Pentiax during Serenity's War, a statue of Bragnott now stands guard in Stoneloom's royal palace, its eyes boring into the souls of all who enter its hallowed halls. Many Stonehearts believe that should an Elder King imperil the kingdom, Bragnott's hammer will strike them down.
